text:
Provides a validated LC-MS/MS method that avoids ion-suppression issues of ion-pairing HPLC by using dephosphorylation and simple aqueous mobile phases. Enables simultaneous quantification of MP and TP forms in multiple blood cell matrices.
The method is susceptible to environmental contamination (e.g., bacteria, dust) which affects the Lower Limit of Quantification (LLOQ), particularly for IMP/ITP. The utility of DBS for accurate nucleotide quantification is limited by instability/hydrolysis of TPs during sample processing and storage, requiring further evaluation or immediate processing protocols.
title: A LC-MS/MS method for quantifying adenosine, guanosine and inosine nucleotides in human cells
